title: USDA Policy Harvest Manifest
description: Top-level array in harvest_manifest.json enumerating every directive to be ingested by the OSCAL and Rego pipelines.

ManifestEntry.title: ManifestEntry
ManifestEntry.description: A single USDA directive entry linking its canonical label to its authoritative source URL and display title.

label.description: Unique directive identifier. Prefix encodes type: DR=Departmental Regulation, DM=Departmental Manual, SM=Secretary's Memorandum, DN=Departmental Notice, DG=Departmental Guideline. Optional suffix (e.g. -A, -01) distinguishes chapters of multi-file manuals.

url.description: Authoritative USDA directives portal URL for the source PDF or HTML document.

title.description: Human-readable directive title including the effective-date annotation when present.
